clusters.headline: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead

clusters.headline: Indonesia reduces gas exports to Singapore in order to 'safeguard reliability' of domestic supplies
clusters.summary: The diversion to meet domestic needs involves 31 million standard cubic feet of natural gas a day from Natuna and Sumatra, Indonesia’s upstream oil and gas regulator told CNA.

clusters.headline: Congo-Kinshasa: As Ebola Spreads to 8th DR Congo Province, Families Battle to Feed Themselves
clusters.summary: [allAfrica] Geneva -- Hunger in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo) is undermining efforts to combat Ebola as the deadly disease has expanded across borders and also to an eighth province of the huge central African country, the UN said on Friday.
